bio: Set in a phenomenal location, the renowned Rosewood Schloss Fuschl has many admirers, and not only among its hotel guests. With its exceptionally upscale and tastefully elegant interior, the restaurant strikes a perfect balance between grandeur and cosy comfort. The large windows offer a magnificent view of the lake. The set menu and à la carte dishes are prepared with select regional ingredients, including produce from the restaurant's own fish farm. The impressive wine list is extensive and includes some prestigious labels. In fine weather, you can also dine on the lakeside terrace one floor up....
